acceptanceCriteria: A bounded, closed adapter-code input exists, either as a harness event field or as a `corvint` adapter-report command.
The OpenCode plugin (integrations/opencode/src/index.js) uses that input for its adapter degradations.

Tests show that `changed-paths-truncated` and `post-tool-path-not-project-relative` each produce a SOL-V0-010 row (host `opencode`) in .corvint/self-observations.jsonl, with no paths and no raw event names, under the same dedup and privacy rules as the Go adapters, and that host output stays non-blocking (AHI-044).
The SOL-V0-010 and AHI-022 specs and their traceability are updated.
body:
Follow-up residual for V1-0746 (PR beamfall/corvint#571, branch claude/v1-0746-adapter-degradations at a3876715, base ce4ae150), filed 2026-10-05 at the request of the claude-mem repository analysis session. V1-0746 stays open: its AC1 is only partly met, and this ticket is the residual.

Context: V1-0746 added ledger rows for the Go adapters' silent abstentions: Codex `unsupported-hook-event` (event `unrecognised`) and Claude Code `post-tool-path-not-project-relative`. The OpenCode plugin (integrations/opencode/src/index.js) now names `changed-paths-truncated` and `post-tool-path-not-project-relative`, but only at info level through record()/console.info. OpenCode has no SOL-V0-010 writer, and the Core harness event has no field that could carry adapter codes to one.

Expected: OpenCode adapter degradations land in .corvint/self-observations.jsonl as SOL-V0-010 rows (host `opencode`), with the same dedup and privacy rules as the Go adapters, and host output stays non-blocking (AHI-044). Actual: they appear in host logs only. Related: V1-0746; also see V1-0294, a different SOL-V0-010 gap for compaction degradations.

completion.reason: Landed on main via beamfall/corvint#580 (merged 2026-10-05T03:06:19Z, merge commit f064522f8bcd4b55d61e4db0ba3a7bcf3ca3e39a). AC1: closed adapter-code input (internal/gokernel/adapter_codes.go, harness.go). AC2: integrations/opencode/src/index.js and runtime.js use it. AC3: integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs and adapter_codes tests cover changed-paths-truncated and post-tool-path-not-project-relative rows under SOL-V0-010 dedup/privacy, non-blocking per AHI-044. AC4: self-observation-ledger-v0 and agent-harness-integration-v0 specs and REQUIREMENTS.tsv updated. Evidence: sealed CEM .corvint/changes/67862d490bc1c94e1cda6f894fc7ddd701627a9f.cem.json and build log docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0767-opencode-adapter-ledger.md at the merge commit. Known limit: the OpenCode host-package version gate stays stale on main until beamfall/corvint#589 (V1-0773, OpenCode 0.7.8) merges.

title: OpenCode adapter abstentions never reach the SOL-V0-010 self-observation ledger
